# Fixture provenance

cnfdb_sample.csv is generated by src/make_fixtures.py from the pinned CNFDB source. It contains small, deterministic selections across reporting agencies and selected missingness, cause and response cases. Synthetic edge cases are created in the tests rather than inserted into the source sample.

Source: Canadian Forest Service, Natural Resources Canada, Canadian National Fire Database - Agency Fire Data. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada. https://open.canada.ca/en/open-government-licence-canada.
